---
title: "Skill tree"
subtitle: "Every article I have written, as a hex. The tree grows outward by year and branches by what the work drew on."
page-layout: full
# This page is dark end to end (navbar, title, tree, footer) so the tree reads as the page rather
# than as a panel dropped onto paper. The class goes on <html> from the head, before first paint,
# so there is no paper flash; the rules live under `html.page-dark` in theme.scss.
include-in-header:
  - text: "<script>document.documentElement.classList.add('page-dark');</script>"
---

<div class="belt-bar--sm belt-bar--center"></div>

```{=html}
<div class="skilltree-wrap">
  <div class="skilltree" id="skilltree" aria-label="Publication skill tree" data-src="www/tree.json">
    <noscript>This page needs JavaScript to draw the tree. The same publications are listed on the CV.</noscript>
  </div>
  <div class="skilltree-legend" id="skilltree-legend" aria-label="Legend"><!-- filled from tree.json by skilltree.js --></div>
</div>
<div class="skilltree-tooltip" id="skilltree-tooltip" role="tooltip" hidden></div>
<aside class="skilltree-panel" id="skilltree-panel" aria-label="Article details" aria-live="polite" hidden>
  <button class="sp-close" type="button" aria-label="Close details">&times;</button>
  <div class="sp-body"><!-- filled by skilltree.js --></div>
</aside>
<script src="www/skilltree.js?v=2026-09-10n" defer></script>
```
